Why you will want it

Ask for where you are or any city. It uses a free weather service and needs no account or key.

Leaving home

You sayAaj baarish hogi kya?

UltronTells you the weather now and the forecast for where you are.

Planning a trip

You sayManali mein is weekend mausam kaisa rahega?

UltronGives the forecast for the city you name.

Morning routine

You sayAaj kitni garmi hai?

UltronReads the current conditions and temperature.

The tool in this connector

Tells you the weather now and for the next few days, for where you are or any city. Ultron picks the right tool from what you say, so you never have to name one.

  • Weather

    Tell the weather now and the forecast (free, no sign-in).
